cards.card_text: They answer, “All that the LORD has spoken we will do, and we will be obedient.”
cards.verse_text: Then he took the Book of the Covenant and read it to the people, who replied, “All that the LORD has spoken we will do, and we will be obedient.”
cards.snippet: …that the LORD has spoken we will do, and we will be obedient.”

cards.card_text: And if they are willing and obedient, the LORD says they will eat the best of the land.
cards.verse_text: If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the best of the land.
cards.snippet: If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the best of the land.

cards.card_text: Back home in Nazareth, Jesus is obedient to His parents.
cards.verse_text: Then He went down to Nazareth with them and was obedient to them.
cards.snippet: Then He went down to Nazareth with them and was obedient to them.

cards.card_text: Among the new believers in Jerusalem, a great number of priests became obedient to the faith.
cards.verse_text: The number of disciples in Jerusalem grew rapidly, and a great number of priests became obedient to the faith.
cards.snippet: …disciples in Jerusalem grew rapidly, and a great number of priests became obedient to the faith.

cards.verse_text: My purpose in writing you was to see if you would stand the test and be obedient in everything.
cards.snippet: …you was to see if you would stand the test and be obedient in everything.

cards.card_text: All obedient with fear and trembling All hesitant with doubts and questions All proud with boasting and praise
cards.verse_text: And his affection for you is even greater when he remembers that you were all obedient as you welcomed him with fear and trembling.
cards.snippet: …for you is even greater when he remembers that you were all obedient as you welcomed him with fear and trembling.

cards.card_text: To make it obedient to Christ To keep their enemies quiet To win every debate in town
cards.verse_text: We demolish arguments and every presumption set up against the knowledge of God; and we take captive every thought to make it obedient to Christ.
cards.snippet: …knowledge of God; and we take captive every thought to make it obedient to Christ.

cards.card_text: Christ Jesus humbled Himself and became obedient to death, even death on a ___.
cards.verse_text: And being found in appearance as a man, He humbled Himself and became obedient to death—even death on a cross.
cards.snippet: …being found in appearance as a man, He humbled Himself and became obedient to death—even death on a cross.

cards.card_text: Then Peter calls them obedient children and brings up the passions of their former ignorance.
cards.verse_text: As obedient children, do not conform to the passions of your former ignorance.
cards.snippet: As obedient children, do not conform to the passions of your former ignorance.

cards.card_text: Peter tells these obedient children to keep shaping their lives around the passions of their former ignorance.
cards.verse_text: As obedient children, do not conform to the passions of your former ignorance.
cards.snippet: As obedient children, do not conform to the passions of your former ignorance.
